title: The Joy Wars Begin: AI Agent Competition Shifts
excerpt: The enterprise AI conversation has pivoted from model superiority to building the most joyous products. AI agents are commoditizing rapidly, making user experience and developer happiness the new competitive battleground.
post_draft:
What if the fastest AI agent isn't the one that wins?

The enterprise AI landscape just shifted beneath our feet. We've moved past the era of "whose model is better" and into something that actually matters more: building products people want to use.

AI agents are becoming commodities. Speed, accuracy, capability—these are table stakes now. The real competition? Making developers happy and creating experiences that users actually enjoy.

This changes everything about how teams should be thinking about AI strategy. It's not about cutting-edge capability anymore. It's about joy.

Read the full article to understand how this shift reshapes enterprise AI priorities and what it means for your product roadmap.
